title: $26 billion of Anthropic's IPO came from its own suppliers
short: Anthropic's record IPO closed at about $119.5 billion. Seven chip, memory and cloud suppliers bought $26 billion of non-voting shares. Full story: https://badeifer.github.io/news/anthropic-ipo-119-billion-chipmakers/ #Anthropic #IPO #AI #Nvidia #Claude
x: Anthropic's IPO closed at about $119.5 billion, and $26.0 billion came from seven of its own chip, memory and cloud suppliers. Shares closed day one up 17 percent. https://badeifer.github.io/news/anthropic-ipo-119-billion-chipmakers/
linkedin:
Anthropic closed its IPO at about $119.5 billion in gross proceeds. $26.0 billion of that came from a private sale of non-voting shares to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC Partners, companies Anthropic pays to build and run Claude.

For developers, that ties Claude's pricing to quarterly earnings now. Watch the first earnings report, any API price or plan changes, and the end of the insider lockup. https://badeifer.github.io/news/anthropic-ipo-119-billion-chipmakers/
